items.topic: Sound not born from sound; distance hearing
items.gist: The passage rejects the idea that sound is born from sound and questions how distant hearing could occur. It argues that sound does not have the required pervasive nature across distances.
Pervasion among elements and tattvas is established by superiority in gunas, not by causality or simplicity. The one with greater gunas is the higher pervader.

items.topic: Shiva onward pervasion; shakti versus dharma
items.gist: From Shiva onward, all tattvas shine as pervaders with their dharmas. The higher tattva is shakti, while the lower is its dharma.
The anuttara procedure has been shown through vaitatya, and the discerning reader may examine it further. Thus the form of tattva has been properly illuminated.
